description: CBTRN02C's TCATBALF CREATE arm reached with a POSITIVE amount - the fourth and last cell of the create-or-rewrite by credit-or-debit matrix, and the one no other case in this folder occupies. WHY THIS CASE EXISTS AND WHY IT IS NOT A SECOND COPY OF case02: 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL at :495-499 branches on WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC - the CREATE arm at :496 when the keyed READ at :474 missed, the REWRITE arm at :498 when it hit - and 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC at :548-552 branches independently on IF DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0, adding to ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT on the true side and to ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT on the ELSE. Two independent binary decisions make four combinations, and the folder pins all four: case01 is REWRITE with a credit, case02 is CREATE with a debit, case12 is REWRITE with a debit, and this case is CREATE with a credit. Until this case was written it and case02 were byte-identical in every member and this combination was reached by nothing at all - so a translation that had, for instance, blanked the trailing FILLER only on the debit side of the create, or added a positive amount to the wrong cycle field when the record was newly created, would have passed the whole folder. HOW THE COMBINATION IS ARRANGED, ENTIRELY FROM UNMODIFIED app/data/ASCII ROWS: the transaction, the cross-reference and the account are case01's - dailytran row 0, DALYTRAN-ID 0000000000683580 on card 4859452612877065, DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD 01, DALYTRAN-CAT-CD 0001 and DALYTRAN-AMT +504.77 stored as 0000005047G, resolved by cardxref row 20 to XREF-ACCT-ID 00000000007, which acctdata row 6 holds with ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT 20650.00, ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE 2024-12-13 (the copybook's own misspelling, kept verbatim - correcting it would leave the diff hunting a span the decoder never produces) and both cycle amounts at 0.00. What differs from case01 is the ONE seeded category balance: tcatbal row 19, keyed 00000000020|01|0001, which belongs to a DIFFERENT ACCOUNT. case01 seeds tcatbal row 6, keyed 00000000007|01|0001, which is exactly the key this transaction composes - so case01 hits and rewrites, and this case misses and creates, on one substituted seed row and nothing else. VALIDATION, IDENTICAL TO case01's BY CONSTRUCTION: all four stages pass, so :211 sends the record to the posting arm at :212 and never to the reject arm at :214-215. 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF at :380-392 finds the card, so reason 100 is not set; 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT at :372-376 finds the account, so reason 101 is not set. COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL at :403-405 is ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT, that is 0.00 - 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77, and :407 finds ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL - 20650.00 against 504.77 - so reason 102 is not set; :414 finds ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10), 2024-12-13 against 2022-06-10, a 10-byte reference modification of the 26-byte timestamp, so reason 103 is not set. This program contains no EVALUATE at all: those four are an ordered nested-IF ladder and their order is part of what is pinned here (gate G30). THE CREATE ARM, AND THE FILLER THAT DISTINGUISHES IT. 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL builds the 17-byte key at :469-471 from XREF-ACCT-ID + DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD + DALYTRAN-CAT-CD, which is 00000000007010001 against a seed keyed 00000000020010001, so the READ at :474 takes its INVALID KEY arm: DISPLAY 'TCATBAL record not found for key : ' FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY '.. Creating.' at :476-477 - the key rendered inside a line whose two spaces before the colon and whose two dots before Creating are literal - and MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC at :478. TCATBALF-STATUS is then '23', which :481 ACCEPTS beside '00', so the tolerance guard passes and no abend follows; case19 reaches that same guard from its failing side. :495-496 therefore performs 2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC, which INITIALIZEs TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD, moves the three key components in, ADDs DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL and WRITEs. The INITIALIZE is what makes the created record distinguishable from a rewritten one by its bytes as well as by its position: it sets the numeric TRAN-CAT-BAL to zero AND the trailing 22-byte alphanumeric FILLER to SPACES, so the created row ends in twenty-two spaces while the seeded row that survives beside it still ends in the twenty-two ZEROS app/data/ASCII/tcatbal.txt carries. The balance is 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77, stored as 0000005047G under the overpunch convention these fixtures use - a positive final digit 0-9 as { A B C D E F G H I and a negative one as } J K L M N O P Q R, so G is a positive 7. THE ACCOUNT'S CREDIT SIDE. 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC at :547 ADDs DALYTRAN-AMT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL, taking 6472.60 to 6977.37 stored as 00000006977G; then :548 finds DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0 and :549 ADDs it TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT, taking 0.00 to 504.77 stored as 00000005047G, while ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT is left at 00000000000{ untouched. The REWRITE at :554 succeeds, so reason 109 is not set - case07 is where that preserved defect is pinned. Both the balance and the credit-cycle field are asserted here, and the debit-cycle field is asserted UNCHANGED, which is the half of the branch a case on the ELSE side cannot state. ROW POSITION IS PART OF THE ASSERTION. The final state is read back in physical-record order, so the seeded row is at index 0 and the appended one at index 1: an appended record is visibly appended, which distinguishes the '23' create arm from the '00' rewrite arm by position before any byte is compared. case01, whose key hit, reports ONE TCATBALF row; this case reports two. WHAT IS NOT HERE: nothing is rejected, so the 430-byte DALYREJS channel is empty and that emptiness is a positive assertion rather than an absence of interest; :229-231 leaves RETURN-CODE at 0 because WS-REJECT-COUNT is zero. The two counter lines report 000000001 processed and 000000000 rejected. DALYTRAN and XREFFILE are opened INPUT and are asserted byte-identical to their seed. The XREFFILE seed is normalised by CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50, because app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt carries 36 bytes per record where app/cpy/CVACT01Y's sibling CVACT03Y declares 50 - the fixture omits the trailing FILLER X(14), and ParityCase.DatasetNormalisation.normaliseSeedRow right-pads at seed time rather than at comparison time, so gate G21's total-width check is a real assertion rather than one that cannot fail. No job parameter is declared, because app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl STEP15 is a bare EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C with no PARM. No unitStimulus is declared either: every arm this case reaches is reachable from its seeded rows, and silence is the declaration that says so. No fully-qualified dataset name appears: a case addresses a dataset by binding key alone. PROVENANCE: statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy, CVACT03Y.cpy, CVACT01Y.cpy, CVTRA01Y.cpy and CVTRA05Y.cpy for the five record geometries, against app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl for the six DDs and the 430-byte reject LRECL, and against the unmodified rows of app/data/ASCII. Nothing here was captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler as disabled, and no Language Environment CEE service exists to link the CALL 'CEE3ABD' this case never reaches. That substitution of provenance, and nothing else about the gate, is the escalated deviation recorded as risk R-A.
